sentences.target: Hey, how's your new dorm room?
sentences.en: Hey, how's your new dorm room?
sentences.es: Oye, ¿qué tal tu nueva habitación en la residencia?
sentences.fr: Hé, comment est ta nouvelle chambre de dortoir ?
sentences.pt: Olá, como está o teu novo quarto no dormitório?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你的新宿舍房间怎么样？
sentences.jp: ねえ、新しい寮の部屋はどう？

sentences.target: It's pretty nice, but the walls are really thin.
sentences.en: It's pretty nice, but the walls are really thin.
sentences.es: Es bastante bonita, pero las paredes son muy finas.
sentences.fr: Elle est plutôt sympa, mais les murs sont vraiment fins.
sentences.pt: É bastante bom, mas as paredes são mesmo finas.
sentences.zh: 挺好的，就是墙真的很薄。
sentences.jp: 結構いいけど、壁がすごく薄いんだ。

sentences.target: Oh, that's a bummer. Can you hear your neighbors a lot?
sentences.en: Oh, that's a bummer. Can you hear your neighbors a lot?
sentences.es: Ah, qué pena. ¿Oyes mucho a tus vecinos?
sentences.fr: Oh, c'est dommage. Tu entends beaucoup tes voisins ?
sentences.pt: Oh, que chatice. Consegues ouvir muito os teus vizinhos?
sentences.kr: 아, 그건 좀 아쉽네. 옆방 소리가 많이 들려?
sentences.zh: 哦，那真遗憾。你能经常听到邻居的声音吗？
sentences.jp: ああ、それは残念だね。隣の人の声がよく聞こえるの？

sentences.target: Yeah, especially at night. I can hear everything they say.
sentences.en: Yeah, especially at night. I can hear everything they say.
sentences.es: Sí, sobre todo por la noche. Puedo oír todo lo que dicen.
sentences.fr: Ouais, surtout la nuit. J'entends tout ce qu'ils disent.
sentences.pt: Sim, especialmente à noite. Consigo ouvir tudo o que eles dizem.
sentences.kr: 응, 특히 밤에 그래. 그들이 말하는 게 다 들려.
sentences.zh: 是啊，尤其是晚上。他们说什么我都能听见。
sentences.jp: うん、特に夜はね。何を言ってるか全部聞こえるよ。

sentences.target: That must be annoying. Have you tried talking to them about it?
sentences.en: That must be annoying. Have you tried talking to them about it?
sentences.es: Eso debe ser molesto. ¿Has intentado hablar con ellos?
sentences.fr: Ça doit être agaçant. Tu as essayé de leur en parler ?
sentences.pt: Isso deve ser irritante. Já tentaste falar com eles sobre isso?
sentences.kr: 그거 정말 짜증 나겠다. 그들한테 얘기해 본 적 있어?
sentences.zh: 那一定很烦人。你有没有试着跟他们谈谈这件事？
sentences.jp: それは困るね。そのことについて話してみたの？

sentences.target: Not yet, but I think I'll mention it tomorrow.
sentences.en: Not yet, but I think I'll mention it tomorrow.
sentences.es: Todavía no, pero creo que lo mencionaré mañana.
sentences.fr: Pas encore, mais je pense que j'en parlerai demain.
sentences.pt: Ainda não, mas acho que vou mencionar isso amanhã.
sentences.kr: 아직은 아니지만, 내일 말해 볼 생각이야.
sentences.zh: 还没有，不过我想明天会提一下。
sentences.jp: まだだけど、明日言ってみようと思ってる。
